SESSION	create temporary view data as select * from values
READ	select g from data order by all

READ	select * from data order by all desc nulls first
READ	select * from data order by all asc nulls last
READ	select * from data order by all desc nulls last

READ	select * from data union select * from data order by all
READ	select * from data order by all limit 2

READ	select name, dept, rank() over (partition by dept order by all) as rank
READ	SELECT all, (SELECT col2 FROM VALUES (2, 2) ORDER BY ALL) FROM VALUES (1) AS t1 (all)
